pla-01.prompt: Flat two-dimensional educational illustration. Simple closed shapes, clear dark outlines, completely solid uniform fills. No gradients, shading or texture. Exactly four completely solid uniform BLUE geometric shapes with matching dark outlines: a circle, a square, an equilateral triangle and a five-pointed star, arranged evenly in a neat two-by-two grid. Identical blue fill for all, equal visual size, wide gaps. No faces, numbers, symbols inside the shapes, no perspective. Concept is different shapes. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background. Show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. Zoom OUT, leave one sixth of canvas width empty at both sides, generous white above and below. Natural anatomically correct hands. Plain shoes and clothing. No border. Absolutely no text, writing, letters, numbers, labels, brand marks, emblems, logos or watermarks anywhere.
